question:
**Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.**

Worried
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Unconcerned**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Worried **means **feeling anxious or concerned about something**.

 
 
• For example, "I am **worried **about my upcoming exam."
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, Leisure, means free time or relaxation.

 
 
• For example, "I enjoy spending my leisure time reading books."
 
 
 
• **Option 2, Withdraw**, means to remove or take back.
 
 
• For example, "I decided to **withdraw **my application for the job."
 
 
 
• **Option 3, Proceed**, means to continue or move forward.
 
 
• For example, "We can **proceed **with the project once we have all the necessary resources."
 
 
 
• Option 4, Unconcerned, means not worried or not caring about something.
 
 
• For example, "He seemed unconcerned about the potential risks of the activity."
 
 
 
• Overall, option 4 is the opposite of worried because it suggests a lack of concern or anxiety.
